description: The dedup read (T4, D5/N3): nearest-neighbour candidates within the bug's OWN project, from the on-demand bug_vec k-NN (S22's pattern — dimension is data, fixed at CREATE, never a migration). It is a READ and a SUGGESTION only — it never sets duplicate_of (only a human confirmation does). The candidates are the bugs whose embedding is nearest, scoped to the same component root (no cross-project). An empty list is the honest absence; the detector suggests, a person confirms.

result.title: retry counter over-counts on the third attempt
